info.title: Switchnote Studio
info.author: RexiMemo!
info.description: Draw and share animations on Switch
info.details:
Create frame-by-frame animations on Nintendo Switch. Draw at 640×360 with four layers, ten ink colours, pens, brushes, erasers, onion skin and eight playback speeds.

Add sound, import pictures, organise Switchnotes locally, export video and share through Switchnote Gallery.

This is a public alpha, so please back up your work.

Launch through Homebrew Menu in app override mode; applet mode is unsupported.

AI use: Human-written.

changelog: Initial public alpha with animation editing, audio, photo import, Gallery and local export.
